margin_units: cost-adjusted utility units; relative Q targets already include registered action costs
selection_rule: ANSWER is the fallback; ASK or DEFER is eligible only when predicted Q_action-Q_ANSWER is strictly greater than the margin
ask_budget: one ASK per policy decision path; an ASK consumes budget; no-information follow-up masks ASK
selection_boundary: fixed small grid for existing Train/Dev only; no Window A confirmation cases
